question: How must the vyāhṛti oblation be offered to the goddess and the lord?
premises: The vyāhṛti oblation follows the material offerings
Both goddess and lord are recipients
The offering is made equally to both
inference: After the material offerings, one should offer the vyāhṛti equally to the goddess and the lord
plain_english: At the end of the material offerings, having offered the vyāhṛti, one should do so equally for the goddess and the lord.
